description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 录屏：画质分小体积、标准、高清、超清四档，超清把不超过 1920×1080 的区域按两倍大小录，彩色文字更清楚；MP4 帧率可选 15 / 30 / 60；可加“鼠标拖尾”；选项排成两列；GIF 可以放弃本次录制。贴图：可以分组（#451），新的“截图并直接贴图”快捷键（#450），连按贴图键找回之前的截图和关掉的贴图（#446），从文件打开的图片按 Ctrl+S 存回原文件（#427），几张一起贴时错开排列，提示浮在贴图外面。截图：新的聚光灯工具（G），长截图连续自动滚动、拼接更稳，识别文字窗口可以合并换行、Ctrl+Enter 复制并关闭，序号工具多了 A B C、Ⅰ Ⅱ Ⅲ、① ② ③ 等写法；翻译服务的密钥不对时直接说明（#444）。插件的日志写进 plugins.log；菜单圆角外不再有方形阴影。权限不变。
notes.en: Recording: four qualities, Ultra recording a region up to 1920×1080 at twice its size for sharp coloured text; MP4 at 15, 30 or 60 frames a second; an optional cursor trail; options in two columns; a GIF can be thrown away. Pins: groups (#451), a capture-and-pin shortcut (#450), the pin key brings back earlier screenshots and closed pins (#446), Ctrl+S saves a picture opened from a file back to it (#427), pins asked for together are set off one another, hints float outside the pin. Screenshot: a Spotlight tool (G), long screenshots scroll by themselves with steadier stitching, the text window joins broken lines and Ctrl+Enter copies and closes, more number styles; a refused translation key is named as such (#444). The plugin's log reaches plugins.log; menus lose the square shadow round their rounded corners. Permissions unchanged.
